article.title: 完形填空 · 跨部门增长团队如何突破业务增长瓶颈
article.context: 文章以 BitTorrent 的案例说明，小企业要突破增长瓶颈，需要建立跨部门增长团队，以不同专业视角协作发现问题，并由强有力的负责人统一目标、排除干扰。
rows: Here's a common scenario that any number of entrepreneurs face today: you're the CEO of a small business, and though you're making a nice profit, you need to find a way to take it to the next level.
这是当下许多创业者都会遇到的常见情形：你是一家小企业的首席执行官，虽然已经获得了不错的利润，却仍需要找到办法让公司更上一层楼。
advance
What you need to do is prioritize growth by establishing a growth team.
你需要做的是把增长置于优先位置，并组建一支增长团队。
emphasize
A growth team is made up of members from different departments within your company, and it harnesses the power of collaboration to focus exclusively on finding ways to grow.
增长团队由公司不同部门的成员组成，它借助协作的力量，专门聚焦于寻找增长路径。
explain
Let's look at a real-world example.
让我们来看一个现实中的例子。
example
Prior to forming a growth team, the software company BitTorrent had 50 employees working in the traditional departments of engineering, marketing and product development.
在成立增长团队之前，软件公司 BitTorrent 有50名员工，分别在工程、营销和产品开发等传统部门工作。
story
This brought them good results until 2012, when their growth plateaued.
这种组织方式一直带来不错的结果，直到2012年公司的增长陷入停滞。
contrast
The problem was that too many customers were using the basic, free version of their product.
问题在于，太多客户只使用其产品的基础免费版本。
explain
And despite improvements to the premium, paid version, few people were making the upgrade.
而且，尽管付费高级版不断改进，真正升级的用户仍寥寥无几。
qualify
Things changed, however, when an innovative project-marketing manager came aboard, created a growth team and sparked the kind of fresh perspective they needed.
然而，一位富有创新精神的项目营销经理加入后，情况发生了变化：他组建增长团队，并激发出了公司所需要的新鲜视角。
action_turn
By looking at engineering issues from a marketing point of view, it became clear that the lack of upgrades wasn't due to a quality issue.
当团队从营销角度审视工程问题时，便清楚地发现，升级不足并不是产品质量造成的。
explain
Most customers were simply unaware of the premium version and what it offered.
大多数客户只是不了解高级版，也不知道它能提供什么。
conclude
Armed with this insight, the marketing and engineering teams joined forces to raise awareness by prominently promoting the premium version to users of the free version.
有了这一洞见，营销和工程团队联手，通过向免费版用户醒目推广高级版来提高认知度。
sequence
As a result, upgrades skyrocketed, and revenue increased by 92 percent.
结果，升级量猛增，收入提高了92%。
conclude
But in order for your growth team to succeed, it needs to have a strong leader.
不过，要让增长团队取得成功，就必须有一位强有力的负责人。
contrast
It needs someone who can unite the interdisciplinary team and keep them on course for improvement.
团队需要一个能够团结跨学科成员、让大家始终沿着改进方向前进的人。
explain
This leader will identify the target area, set clear goals and establish a time frame for the accomplishment of these goals.
这位负责人要确定目标领域、设定清晰目标，并为目标的完成规定时间框架。
sequence
The growth leader is also responsible for keeping the team focused on moving forward and steering them clear of distractions.
增长团队负责人还要确保团队专注于向前推进，并使其远离干扰。
emphasize
While attractive, new ideas can be distracting; the team leader must recognize when these ideas don't serve the current goal and need to be put on the back burner.
新的想法虽然诱人，却也可能分散注意力；团队负责人必须判断这些想法何时无助于当前目标，并把它们暂时搁置。
